Students, start here

Your Path

Discover, Prepare, Launch is how OWU students design their careers. Start where you are and move forward at your own pace.

Students, start here

Three stages. One path that's yours.

Our Discover, Prepare, Launch model is rooted in Design Thinking. Start where you are, and move forward at your own pace.

1

Discover

Start where you are. Use assessments to learn what makes you stand out and find routes forward.

  • Take CliftonStrengths →
  • Explore if you're undecided →
  • Designing Your Future course →
2

Prepare

Become the designer of your life. Hold exploratory conversations and build more than one path.

  • Resume & cover letters →
  • Networking & LinkedIn →
  • Workplace Readiness Certificate →
3

Launch

Set growth goals, close skill gaps, and say yes to the opportunities that excite you.

  • Find a job or internship →
  • Ace the interview →
  • Apply for grant funds →
